description: Intellectual property law reference covering ownership, licensing, copyright, trade secrets, and allocation of IP risk in technology and services agreements.

obligations.title: Ownership and Assignment of Work Product
obligations.description: Define whether new inventions, derivative works, and work product are assigned to the customer or retained by the developer, and specify the scope of assignment.

obligations.title: License Scope for Background IP
obligations.description: If either party provides background IP, define the license scope needed to perform the agreement (e.g., internal use, sublicensing limits, territory, term).

obligations.title: Trade Secrets and Confidentiality Alignment
obligations.description: Ensure that confidentiality provisions protect trade secrets and include procedures for handling and disclosure consistent with IP protection.

obligations.title: Infringement Risk Allocation
obligations.description: Include mechanisms for infringement claims (e.g., indemnity, alternatives like replacement/modification) appropriate to the parties' roles.
